name: angeloyal-operations-management
description: AngeLoyal Logistics - Operations Management System (Cloudflare Pages + D1)

scripts.deploy:dev: wrangler pages deploy web --project-name angeloyal-oms --branch develop --commit-dirty=true
scripts.release: wrangler pages deploy web --project-name angeloyal-oms --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply angeloyal-oms-dev --env preview --remote
scripts.db:export:dev: wrangler d1 export angeloyal-oms-dev --env preview --remote --output data/d1-dev-export.sql

scriptsHelp.test: run the local test suite (node:sqlite in memory; no wrangler, no live database)
scriptsHelp.dev:web: serve web/ + the /api function on :8788 against the local D1 (see db:* below)
scriptsHelp.release: deploy main to angeloyal-oms.pages.dev (PROD D1) — only from main, after tagging
scriptsHelp.db:migrate:local | db:migrate:dev | db:m: apply migrations/ to the local / DEV / PROD D1
scriptsHelp.db:seed:local: load data/d1-import.sql into the local D1
scriptsHelp.db:export:dev | db:export:prod: dump the remote DEV / PROD D1 to data/ as SQL (backup)
scriptsHelp.db:migrate-sheets: data/sheets-snapshot.json -> data/d1-import.sql, with the reconciliation report
scriptsHelp.fetch-data: snapshot the v1 PROD Sheet to data/ through the deployed Apps Script; add -- --dev for DEV. Delete after the v2.0.0 cutover
scriptsHelp.changelog:sync: regenerate web/changelog.json from GitHub Releases (add -- --apply to write)
scriptsHelp.backlog:sync: regenerate BACKLOG.md from the GitHub Project board
